animationPayload.correctionNote: George Quinn polled 369, not 309, heading the ward ahead of Teague Boyle's 338: both the Londonderry Sentinel and the Londonderry Standard print 369. The file had no party labels; the Sentinel prints Quinn, Boyle and Maguire as Independent Labour and Patrick White as the Trades Council candidate. (Londonderry Sentinel, Londonderry Sentinel, 19 May 1955, p. 3)
